name: Agriculture, Grains & Fertilizer
edge: Weather- and policy-driven; the key data (USDA) is public and scheduled.

catalysts.title: Drought / crop-damaging weather
catalysts.logic: Weather damage in a key exporter -> lower supply -> higher grain prices.

catalysts.title: Grain export ban / restriction
catalysts.logic: Exporter halts shipments -> scarcity -> bullish grains / competing exporters.

catalysts.title: Fertilizer / potash supply shock
catalysts.logic: Potash/nitrogen supply cut -> higher input prices -> bullish producers.

catalysts.title: USDA WASDE / crop report surprise
catalysts.logic: Scheduled report - trade the SURPRISE vs expectation, not the level.
